title: Volume Relief Schedule on the Margin Allowed on a Refined Fuels and Propane Account
content:
The margin allowed on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is relieved where the account has taken enough fuel over the year and drawn enough of it against its bookings. The relief is a figure in USD per gallon taken off the programme's posted price margin.

| Gallons taken on the account in the twelve months ending on the handling date | Gallons drawn against bookings | Margin allowed on the account |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1800 gallons or more | 1000 gallons or more | The programme's posted price margin, reduced by 0.06 USD per gallon |
| 900 gallons or more, and fewer than 1800 gallons | Any figure | The programme's posted price margin, reduced by 0.03 USD per gallon |
| Any other case | Any figure | The programme's posted price margin |

## Points of judgement on the lines

**The first line asks two things.** Both must hold: the gallons taken on the account in the twelve months ending on the handling date must reach 1800, and the gallons drawn against bookings must reach 1000. An account at 1800 gallons taken but only 900 gallons drawn against its bookings does not meet the first line.

**The second line asks one thing, within a band.** The gallons taken must reach 900 and must fall short of 1800. The gallons drawn against bookings do not enter it.

**The third line is the rest.** An account that meets neither of the lines above is allowed the programme's posted price margin with nothing taken off it — which takes in, among others, an account at 1800 gallons or more taken whose drawdown falls short of 1000 gallons.

*Hypothetical, on the boundaries.* An account with 1800.0 gallons taken in the window and 1000.0 gallons drawn against its bookings meets both tests exactly, and the relief of 0.06 USD per gallon applies. At 1799.0 gallons taken and the same drawdown, the gallons fall in the band of the second line and the relief is 0.03 USD per gallon. At 899.0 gallons taken, no relief applies at all. At 1800.0 gallons taken and 999.0 gallons drawn, the first line fails on its second test and the second line fails because the gallons taken are not below 1800, so no relief applies.
